tool_input.command: bunx guren check --arch 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "exit=$?"; rm app/ArchProbe.ts routes/archProbe.ts; git status --short
tool_input.description: Verify arch rule fails on probes, then remove them

result:
The newsletter sign-up is in place as a self-contained module. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass (19 tests, 17 of them new), and `bunx guren check`, `bunx guren check --arch` and `bunx guren gate` report no failures. Nothing is committed.

I also confirmed the boundary rule bites: with a temporary file under `app/` importing `modules/newsletter/index.ts` and one under `routes/` importing `modules/newsletter/db/schema.ts`, the check reported each as a failure. Both probe files are removed.

Three things you might not expect:

- **Root `db/schema.ts` has one new line.** It re-exports the module's schema, which is how `guren make:module` wires modules so the migration tooling sees the table. The table definition itself lives only in `modules/newsletter/db/schema.ts`.
- **Redirect back only follows a same-origin `Referer`.** Anything else (or no header) goes to `/`, so the routes can't be used as an open redirect.
- **Emails are lowercased before storing and matching.** `Reader@Example.com` and `reader@example.com` count as the same subscription.

Two consequences of the requested behaviour, for the confirmation-email ticket:

- Unsubscribing needs only an email address, so anyone who knows an address can remove it.
- Confirming is a `GET` that writes, so link scanners that prefetch URLs will confirm on the reader's behalf.

**Summary of changes:** I scaffolded `modules/newsletter/` with `guren make:module`, which registered `newsletterModule` in `src/app.ts` and added the schema re-export to `db/schema.ts`. Inside the module: `db/schema.ts` defines `newsletter_subscriptions`; `app/Models/NewsletterSubscription.ts` is the model (only `email` fillable); `app/Http/Validators/SubscriptionValidator.ts` holds the email schemas; `app/Http/Controllers/SubscriptionController.ts` implements subscribe, confirm and unsubscribe; `routes.ts` registers `POST /newsletter/subscribe`, `GET /newsletter/confirm/:token` and `POST /newsletter/unsubscribe`; and `tests/controllers/SubscriptionController.test.ts` covers them. Outside the module: the migration `db/migrations/20260929145805_create_newsletter_subscriptions/`, a new root `guren.arch.ts` forbidding `app/**` and `routes/**` from importing `modules/newsletter/**` (type-only imports included), `modules/**/*` added to the `tsconfig.json` include, regenerated `.guren/api-client.gen.ts` and `.guren/routes.gen.ts`, and the decision recorded in `docs/adr/0002-newsletter-sign-up-lives-in-a-self-contained-module.md`.
